company.shortDescription: Red Sea Farms is an agriculture technology company enabling the commercial farming of produce using primarily salt water.
company.description: Red Sea Farms offers diverse products and services including produce technology and consultancy. Their patent-pending technology enables greenhouse and hydroponic farms to grow more and better food with less water and energy - saving money and sustainably increasing profits. The company's team of experts provides technical advice on design and project management for saltwater and desert agriculture.
